Description:
[size=4]這是由[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url]﻿製作的圖塊模組[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]的 i18n 格式版本。[/size]

﻿>已將原始檔案改為 [color=#f4cccc]i18n 版本[/color], 方便後續語言擴充與維護[/size]

[size=4]This is an i18n-formatted version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿, a tilesheet mod created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url]﻿.[/size]
[size=3]  ﻿>This page provides[color=#f4cccc] translation files only[/color][/size]
[size=3]  ﻿>The [color=#f4cccc]original mod must be downloaded[/color] from the Original File page[/size]
[size=3]  ﻿>The original files have been converted to an [color=#f4cccc]i18n-compatible format[/color] for easier language expansion and maintenance[/size]
[size=3]  ﻿>Translation mainly applies to [color=#f4cccc]menu and text-related content[/color][/size]

[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url]: (引用原作者說明)
﻿>for modders: feel free to use them in your maps! Just add this mod as a dependency when you upload yours.
﻿>for players: this mod doesn't do anything to your game on its own! It's just used by other mods.
﻿>arrows: [/size][size=4]This mod replaces some symbols in the font_bold tilesheet to add more arrows for use in sign messages.[/size]

[size=4][color=#cc0000]注意[/color]:
﻿>DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets 本身僅提供圖塊素材
>﻿單獨下載不會改變遊戲畫面, 需要下載關聯的模組。
﻿>僅作為其他模組的 前置需求（Dependency）
﻿>此i18n檔案需要安裝原始模組, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿。[/size]

[size=4][color=#ff0000]Notes[/color]:[/size]
[size=4]  ﻿>DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets is a tilesheet resource mod only[/size]
[size=4]  ﻿>Downloading it alone will not change in-game visuals[/size]
[size=4]  ﻿>It is intended to be used as a dependency for other mods[/size]
[size=4]  ﻿>This i18n file requires the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url] mod[/size]



[size=2][color=#6aa84f]如何安裝[/color]:[/size]
[spoiler][size=2]>﻿下載[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿和本檔案DaisyNiko's Tilesheets- i18n Taiwanese translation。
>﻿先﻿把原始模組檔案 [CP] DaisyNiko's Tilesheets 放入MODs資料夾內,
>﻿﻿再把 DaisyNiko's Tilesheets- i18n Taiwanese translation 資料夾裡面的 [CP] DaisyNiko's Tilesheets 移到MODs資料夾裡,
﻿>這樣就可以了。[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]
[color=#6aa84f]Installation[/color]:[/size]

[spoiler][size=2]﻿>Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿ and DaisyNiko's Tilesheets- i18n
﻿>Place the original [CP] DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets folder into your Mods directory
﻿>Move the [CP] DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets folder from the DaisyNiko's Tilesheets - i18n folder into your Mods directory
﻿>done.[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]

[color=#e69138]Vortex安裝說明[/color]：[/size]
[spoiler][size=2]>此檔案可使用Vortex自動安裝, 用〔Mod manager download〕下載兩個檔案,
﻿>在Vortex介面點入左側 Mods , 會有 DaisyNiko's Tilesheets 和 DaisyNiko's Tilesheets- i18n Taiwanese translation,
﻿>先安裝DaisyNiko's Tilesheets, 
﻿>之後安裝本檔案DaisyNiko's Tilesheets- i18n Taiwanese translation,
>﻿(嫌麻煩就同時選取兩個檔案安裝也沒事)
﻿>這樣就好了哦~ 不會跳出衝突![/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]

[color=#f1c232]補充[/color]:
﻿>原模主頁面有相容性的外觀mod, 有興趣的可以去看看~
﻿>如果出現缺字, 請下載並安裝[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8007]Traditional Chinese Translation[/url], 啟用字型, 或是下載字型齊全的中文字型mod安裝吧!
﻿>我是因為Less Ugly Town Interiors這款mod才會翻譯DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets, 我個人偏好原版的設計再去加以潤色, 其他版本的外觀mod就不會去關注了。 如果還有其他原版潤色的mod, 可以推薦給我看看哦!
﻿>[s]如果不喜歡在GMCM看到中文字, 可以到manifest.json檔案裡面, 把中文字刪除就可以囉! [/s]想看到中文的模組名稱可以下載 DaisyNiko's Tilesheets - personal , 也可以到GMCM Mod Name I18n - Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) Addon和GMCMModNameI18n下載模組名稱翻譯包。

[color=#ffd966]Additional Notes[/color]:
﻿>[/size]The original mod page lists several compatible visual mods. Feel free to check them out if you’re interested
﻿>If you don’t want to see Chinese text in GMCM, just go to the manifest.json file and delete the Chinese characters.
